mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 7.5% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which increases the risk of recession and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 7.5%, or the signal fails to generate a negative return in 70% of triggered cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction permits (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates weakening aggregate demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities due to reduced corporate revenue expectations over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 60% of cases over 60-day horizons, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.02 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 99.0 for two consecutive months signals a contraction in real output, which increases the probability of a recession and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 99.0, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPIAUCSL above 2.5% year-over-year, combined with a stable or rising federal funds rate, indicates persistent inflationary pressure that triggers a hawkish monetary policy response, leading to higher discount rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances despite CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY and FEDFUNDS ≥ 0.15%, or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average, coupled with rising industrial production (INDPRO), indicates strong aggregate demand momentum that supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive in more than 60% of instances where both RSAFS > 12mo MA and INDPRO > 99.0, or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 200k per month, combined with a declining unemployment rate (UNRATE), signals a tight labor market that increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS > 200k and UNRATE < 7.8%, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in GDP growth (GDPC1) below 2.0% annualized, as measured over the past four quarters, signals a weakening economy that reduces corporate profitability and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 < 2.0% annualized, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
